_comment: Frontier lane for GRPO train-task selection: short (<=12 expected actions), idempotent, oracle-checked tasks on bot-wall-free sites. Every task carries a success_check (deterministic value, stable ID/slug, or URL pattern) and 1-2 milestones for partial credit. _config.exclude_domains = every domain in the archived Online-Mind2Web 50-task eval sample (benchmark stays out of training even at domain level); _config.exclude_sites = sites grpo-v2 proved bot-walled. Selection into the train set happens by measured pass@8 (cua/rl/analysis.py select-frontier), never by hand.
